question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution: The correct answer is **"carry around."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Carry around"** means to have something with you wherever you go. (आप जहां भी जाएं अपने साथ कुछ न कुछ रखना) • The phrase can be used literally or figuratively. • **Example**:* "I always **carry around**__ a water bottle with me."* • Grammatically, the phrasal verb **"carry around"** is intransitive and separable. • The correct answer is Option 4. • Correct passage: Today, I want to talk to you about a very simple matter, that is, simple conversations. When we learn to speak, __first__ come words, then phrases, and then scripts. You would agree that the larger the bundles of words we __**carry around**__, the less we have to worry about combining them into sensible ______ (3) ______. Also the less we have to fret over syntax or ______ (4) ______. Do you think you choose the words? Do you pre-rehearse every time you go out? ______ (5) ______ what happens when you walk into a fast-food restaurant. My dear, how do you react in those real life situations? [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Ask around"** means to ask multiple people for information or advice. (जानकारी या सलाह के लिए कई लोगों से पूछना) • **"Bail out"** means to leave a difficult situation or to help someone else out of trouble. (किसी कठिन परिस्थिति को छोड़ना या किसी और को परेशानी से बाहर निकालने में मदद करना) • **"Look after"** means to take care of or be responsible for someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु की देखभाल करना या उसके प्रति जिम्मेदार होना) 44:Tf4e, The correct answer is **"expressions."**
